search_intent.primary_query: UK Civil Service senior role Success Profiles evidence
search_intent.intent: Unmeasured candidate-information hypothesis: translate actual senior experience into evidence relevant to a UK Civil Service vacancy's stated Success Profile elements and assessment method.
evidence: Official Success Profiles guidance states that profiles draw on five elements and that the elements vary by role.
Official experience guidance says experience is often needed for senior roles and may be assessed through an application form, CV or interview.

intended_audience: Senior candidates applying to UK Civil Service roles that specify Success Profiles assessment.
geographic_relevance: United Kingdom Civil Service recruitment guidance only. Do not generalize to private employers or other jurisdictions.
